entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The pulse tracker is a joke. It's completely inaccurate. The whole thing is just garbage.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can transfer you to our technical support team; they have a few quick troubleshooting steps that can usually recalibrate the sensor.
No. I don't have time for that. I'm not interested in fixing it. I just want money back. I want a refund.

I understand you'd prefer not to troubleshoot. Let me just pull up your order details and review the return eligibility. Can I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. The VeloBand GPS Tracker was delivered on December 18th, which was 22 days ago. Let me check the policy.

Alright, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're at day 22, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and process this return for you.
Fine. Are you sending a shipping label?

Yes. I've just initiated the return authorization. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and packing instructions within the next 5-10 minutes. Once our warehouse receives the band, your full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Whatever. Just make sure it actually shows up.
You will receive another email notification as soon as the refund is processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sarah?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
